{{Quote|The way of the Bantha is one of majestic beauty and calm peace. Oneness with the natural world. We strive to understand the power of the creature.|Dim-U Priestess|<ref name="GG7" />}}
The '''Dim-U''' were a sect of [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]]-worshiping monks. Their beliefs were based on the unexplained presence of banthas on [[Planet/Legends|planets]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. They believed this to be a message from a higher power, and that once this message was unraveled, an "Age of Bounty" would come. Since they considered banthas holy, they would not eat bantha meat or wear bantha hides. Dim-U monks preached their religion on hundreds of worlds.<ref name="Tatooine Manhunt">''[[Tatooine Manhunt]]''</ref>

[[File:Bantha_bull.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A bantha, object of Dim-U worship]]

==Overview==
{{Quote|A fanatical religious organization that worshipped banthas.|[[Mayor/Legends|Mayor]] [[Mikdanyell Guh'rantt]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:MMG">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=conversation|Mayor Mikdanyell Guh'rantt|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
The Dim-U would refer to the bantha in a number of ways, such as the "Mighty Bantha", "Horned-One", "Revered Bantha", "Wandering Bantha", "Enduring Bantha", and "Stalwart Bantha".<ref name="SWG:BD">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Bantha Defender}}</ref>

Many Dim-U monks lived on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. They resided mostly in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] at the [[Dim-U monastery/Legends|Dim-U monastery]] and in an [[Oasis (community)|Oasis community]] in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]].<ref name="Tatooine Manhunt" /> The Mos Eisley monastery had differences of opinion with the Oasis community. The monastery was headed by [[Abbot]] [[Drayk]], primarily as a front for his [[Computer/Legends|computer]] [[Slicer/Legends|slicing]] business on the side. The monks had a "back door" into the [[Bureau of Ships and Services/Legends|Bureau of Ships and Services]] mainframe which allowed them to alter [[Starship/Legends|ship]] [[transponder]] codes. Other monks were trained technicians who could discretely and ably install illegal upgrades to ships, including weaponry. Drayk himself had access to a network of underworld contacts, and could put clients in contact with beings able to serve their needs, for a price. The monastery charged about double the open market price for such services.<ref name="GG7" /> Drayk and the Dim-U had managed to avoid being forced to affiliate with [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]].<ref name="Secrets of Tatooine">''[[Secrets of Tatooine]]''</ref>

The Dim-U monks of Tatooine once contracted [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to eliminate poachers who sold the meat and the hide of the bantha.<ref name="SWG:BD" />
